requirements.text: The ability for patients to book, cancel, or change appointments.
The option for patients to request repeat prescriptions.
The ability to check test results after a doctor's review.
A secure messaging feature for patients to communicate with staff.
There should be a way to verify patient identity before they can access their health information.
All personal information needs to be kept private and secure, both during transmission and while stored.
Compliance with relevant regulations regarding patient data.
